result.reason: The redline gives Company a 30-day written convenience-termination right covering the Agreement and active SOWs, requires a pro-rata-style refund of prepaid post-termination fees, and bars any early-termination charge. Contractor may terminate only when no SOW remains outstanding and on 90 days’ notice, so it cannot terminate for convenience during an active commitment. The changes are targeted and preserve the remaining term structure. Drafting is professional, though Contractor’s notice should preferably be expressly written and the notice phrases should use the possessive form (“days’ advance notice”).
